label: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare API tokens and the global API key, for the API and Wrangler.

signals.reason: The global API key acts on the whole account, with R2, D1, and KV data. A deleted bucket or database cannot be restored.
A Cloudflare API token has the permissions that the owner selected, so Apassy does not suggest the scope.
The item name or a label names Cloudflare or Wrangler.
A host of the item is a Cloudflare host.
